limitations: Only real, unweighted, even n-gonal prism graph metrics with n>=4; no claim about odd prisms, weighted metrics or complete face vectors. Unindexed equivalent enumerations cannot be excluded; independent audit outstanding.
scientific_integrity: Analytic bijection and published planar facet-flow correspondence prove the theorem; exact enumerations only check finitely many cases. Published prior framework and its outerplanar formula are explicitly acknowledged.
title: Balanced ternary classification of facets of even prism Lipschitz-free balls
